title: A deposit under the wrong payer is reversed and taken again under the new one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, picked by mistake as the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the right payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one $10.00 deposit taken under customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
  5. Reverse the $10.00 deposit.
  6. Expand the Customer card.
  7. Click the Bill To field.
  8. Pick customer C in the list.
  9. Open the Finance tab.
  10. Click Add Deposit.
  11. Pick a Payment Method.
  12. Enter 10.00 as the Deposit Amount.
  13. Click Submit Deposit.
  14. Open customer C's Deposits tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."

Step 4:

  • The Finance tab lists the $10.00 deposit.

Step 5:

  • The deposit is reversed.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 7:

  • The list opens: the field is unlocked.

Step 8:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 9:

  • The Finance tab shows Add Deposit.

Step 10:

  • The Create Deposit window opens.

Step 11:

  • The Payment Method is picked.

Step 12:

  • Deposit Amount shows 10.00.

Step 13:

  • The deposit is recorded.

Step 14:

  • The $10.00 deposit for work order 1 is listed on customer C's Deposits tab.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits), story SV-12313 (Story 11, Reverse and invoice again)

  • S11-E1: “A deposit taken under the wrong Bill To must be reversed and taken again under the new Bill To (M1 says so).”
  • Key Decisions: “Deposits lock the Bill To. A deposit belongs to the Bill To it was taken under and never moves between customers. The refusal names the amount and payer and opens the payer's Deposits tab. A payment may use only deposits and credits held by the paying customer.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Pick or change the Bill To | Allowed. Refused while deposits are held (M1). | Read-only (M4) | No Bill To”
